newsitem.title: CROATIA: EBRD, Croatian Devt bank sign 105 German mark loan.
newsitem.headline: EBRD, Croatian Devt bank sign 105 German mark loan.

text.p: Croatia's Bank for Reconstruction and Development (HBOR) on Monday signed a 105 million German mark loan with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), state news agency HINA reported.
The loan will be used to finance local infrastructure and environment protection projects in the southern coastal region of Dalmatia, the agency said.
The projects will also include the clean-up of the polluted Kastela Bay, a heavy industrial zone adjacent to Adriatic seaside resorts, HBOR director Antun Kovacev said.
The loan is the biggest ever granted by the EBRD to a transitional country, HINA said. The EBRD in June lent Croatia 50 million marks to prepare for the summer tourist season, it said.
